# Why hod declines the x86-64 corpus

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask corpus reasons --target x86_64 --report <this file>`. Do not edit: run the command again. -->

Every module of the captured corpus (`docs/status/corpus-x64-census.md`, captured for x86-64), given to hod in strict mode with its `llc` arguments: as bitcode from its LLVM's `llvm-as`, read natively (the default route). The first refusal is the reason the coverage log records; the census (`HOD_CENSUS=1`) is every reason, the list of what to implement next (`spec/cli.md` "Reasons"). A count is of modules.

## What the built modules do

From `cargo xtask corpus verify --target x86_64` (hybrid: a module hod declines is built by `llc`): every entry linked by each linker and run under the emulator, its output and exit status compared with the entry's. A test counts as built by hod when hod built its every module. A FAIL in a test hod built is a wrong result unless the entry's program is undefined. Tests are named by their path in the corpus.

| LLVM | tests | built by hod | results | PASS | FAIL | ERROR | other | PASS of hod's |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 22 | no `verify-x86_64-llvm22-hybrid.tsv` | | | | | | | |
| 19 | no `verify-x86_64-llvm19-hybrid.tsv` | | | | | | | |

## The routes agree

Modules whose outcome and first reason are the same by two routes, and whose census is the same set of reasons. The census's order is the order the reasons were met, which follows each reader's numbering of symbols (`hod_ll` numbers a symbol at its first mention, `hod_bc` in record order); the last column counts the modules whose census is in the same order by all three routes.

| LLVM | modules | text = native | native = `llvm-dis` | census: text = native | census: native = `llvm-dis` | census in the same order |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 22 | 3510 | 3510 | 3509 | 3510 | 3509 | 3509 |
| 19 | 3468 | 3468 | 3467 | 3468 | 3467 | 3467 |

The modules that differ (at most 20):

- `kiln/llvm22/conformance/temp.arg.nontype/class-type-argument-debuginfo-run.cpp.ll`: text `-` (-), native `-` (-), `llvm-dis` `malformed-input` (malformed-input)
- `kiln/llvm19/conformance/temp.arg.nontype/class-type-argument-debuginfo-run.cpp.ll`: text `-` (-), native `-` (-), `llvm-dis` `malformed-input` (malformed-input)
